sources: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/64uk-42ks (NYC DCP PLUTO 26v2: bldgarea, lotarea, yearbuilt, unitsres, bctcb2020)
filters: building class category 01 or 02 at sale
sale price >= $25,000 (DOF glossary: a $0 sale is a transfer without cash consideration)
same date and price on more than one lot in the same tax block dropped (package sales)
PLUTO: 1-2 residential units, building area >= 400 sq ft, year built not after the sale year
